caption: A booked slot that sits empty costs you the job and the time you set aside for it. If every customer got a friendly reminder before their appointment, and a quick way to reschedule, how many of those gaps would you get back?

slides.headline: They booked. They didn't turn up.
You kept the time free.
slides.body: You turned other work away, got ready and waited. Nobody came.

slides.headline: Usually it's not rudeness. They forgot.
slides.body: The booking was made days ago and life got in the way.

slides.headline: Chasing them costs you more time.
slides.body: Another call, another message, and the gap in your day is still there.

slides.headline: What if they got a reminder first?
slides.body: Your agent messages before the appointment and asks them to confirm.

slides.headline: Same booking. No empty chair.
slides.body: Confirmed or rescheduled, you know where your day stands.
